channel.title: Optimizing Multi-App Management with Unified Webhooks on AWS Amplify Hosting :: Báo cáo AWS Workshop
channel.description: OPTIMIZING MULTI-APP MANAGEMENT WITH UNIFIED WEBHOOKS ON AWS AMPLIFY HOSTING In modern software engineering, the Monorepo architecture (managing multiple frontend apps and services in a single repository) is highly favored by developers due to easy code sharing and streamlined workspace management. However, when deploying these applications on AWS Amplify Hosting, developers often hit a painful barrier: Git Provider Webhook limits.
